items.question: How does delivery work?
items.answer: Orders are fulfilled by verified sellers and tracked from checkout to delivery.

items.question: Can I manage business orders online?
items.answer: Yes. Your account keeps orders, saved items, cart details, and purchase activity together.

items.question: Is payment secure?
items.answer: Checkout supports secure payment review, delivery address confirmation, and order verification.

items.question: How do returns work?
items.answer: Eligible products can be returned or replaced according to the seller and category policy.
